items.text:
Title: Release Readiness Review — Orbit 4.2
Time: Thursday 14:00–15:00 (Zoom)
Description: Final go/no-go for the 4.2 release. Please review the previous release's postmortem and the open blockers before we meet. Priya will walk through the rollout plan, and Marco from support will share the top five customer issues. We also need to decide whether the new onboarding assistant (the chatbot that greets new users) ships behind a flag or in the default flow. Bring your notes on the admin console changes — the security team flagged two UI permissions that still need sign-off. If you can't make it, email me your vote by 12:00.

Title: Emergency: Train Strike Contingency Planning
Time: Friday 09:00–10:00 (Room 3B)
Description: As you know, the RMT strike is set for next Tuesday and Wednesday. We need to finalize our remote-work policy for those days and arrange carpooling for the support team. Please check the previous announcement from HR and bring any urgent concerns from your teams. The automated scheduling tool has already flagged conflicts for three people — we'll sort those out together. This is important, so please prioritize attendance.

Title: Security Audit Findings — Action Required
Time: Monday 11:00–12:30 (Conference Room A)
Description: The external auditors have completed their review of our payment flow. They found three medium-severity issues that we need to address this sprint. The previous audit's remediation took two weeks, so we should aim for a similar timeline. I've attached the full report; please read the summary before the meeting. We'll assign owners for each finding. Note: the auditors used an automated scanner as well as manual testing, so some findings may be false positives — we'll triage those together. This is urgent, so please make time.

Title: Post-Release Retro — Orbit 4.2
Time: Wednesday 10:00–11:30 (Zoom)
Description: Now that 4.2 is out, let's gather to discuss what went well and what didn't. We'll review the incident where the admin dashboard briefly showed stale data (fixed within 20 minutes). Please come prepared to talk about the rollout pace and the support load. The new onboarding assistant got positive feedback, but we should check if its prompts need tweaking. Also, we need to plan the next release, 4.3, and decide if we can include the long-awaited export feature.

Agenda:
1. Incident review (15 min)
2. Metrics: adoption and error rates (15 min)
3. Feedback from support and sales (20 min)
4. Action items and owners (20 min)
5. Next steps for 4.3 (20 min)

Please add any additional items to the agenda doc by Tuesday EOD. If you can't attend, send a delegate.

intent.requested_action: attend meeting and contribute agenda items

items.text:
Title: Urgent: Strike Impact on Data Center Access
Time: Tuesday 08:00–08:30 (Phone bridge)
Description: Due to the train strike, only essential staff will be on-site. Please confirm if you can cover the morning shift. The automated access system will be set to limited entry, so bring your badge. If you can't make it, call me ASAP.

Title: Audit Follow-Up: Evidence Collection
Time: Thursday 15:00–16:00 (Small Conference Room)
Description: We need to collect evidence for the security audit's open items. Please upload the previous quarter's logs to the shared folder before the meeting. The compliance assistant (the tool that checks document completeness) will pre-validate the files, but we still need a human review. This is a priority.

Title: Orbit 4.2 Release: Final Checklist Review
Time: Friday 13:00–14:00 (Zoom)
Description: We're T-minus 2 hours from the release window. Let's do a final run-through of the checklist and make sure everything is in place. I've attached the checklist; please review it beforehand. The on-call engineer will be standing by. Remember, the admin console feature flag must be turned on only after the security team gives the green light. Also, we need to confirm that the release notes are ready for the support team. If any urgent issues come up, we'll address them here. The automated deployment script will run at 15:00 sharp, so we need to be done by then. Join the Zoom bridge at 13:00.

Title: Strike Update: Revised Commute Guidance
Time: Monday 16:00–16:30 (Email summary)
Description: HR has updated the commute guidance for the strike days. Please read the attached PDF and note the changes to the shuttle schedule. The automated travel assistant can help you plan alternative routes — check the intranet for details. This is not urgent, but please review before Tuesday.

Title: Security Audit: Pre-Audit Walkthrough
Time: Tuesday 10:00–11:30 (Conference Room B)
Description: Before the auditors arrive next week, let's do an internal walkthrough of the areas they'll focus on: access control, data encryption, and incident response. Please review the previous audit's findings and come with updates on remediation. The admin team has prepared a demo of the new logging system. We'll also discuss how the automated monitoring tool alerts us to anomalies. This is a dry run, so don't worry about perfection — we want to catch gaps early.

Please bring:
- A list of any changes since the last audit
- Questions for the auditors
- Your team's availability for the audit week

If you can't attend, send a representative.

Title: Post-Strike Debrief
Time: Thursday 09:00–09:30 (Teams)
Description: Quick sync to discuss how the strike days went and what we can improve next time. Please note any issues you encountered. The automated survey results will be shared during the call. Not urgent, but valuable.
